Class RcxRegulatedDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxRegulatedDiagnostics
public final class RcxRegulatedDiagnostics extends Object
Diagnostics read from the brick for a regulated pair, for tuning and floor tests: the control-cycle counter, which gives the brick's cycle rate, and how the wheel sync drives each side. Reads change no state of the pair, and the drive values are kept in fields, so polling them allocates nothing. Get it from RcxRegulatedPair.diagnostics().

  • Method Details

    • controlCycles

      public int controlCycles()
      The brick's count of regulator control cycles since it booted, 0 to 65535 and wrapping, or -1 when it did not answer. Two reads a known time apart give the cycle rate, which the firmware's time base must match.

    • refreshDrive

      public boolean refreshDrive()
      Reads each side's motor power this cycle (0 while it is braked) and the cycles of the current motion each was held braked to let the other catch up. Returns whether the brick answered; the values are then in leftPower() and the like.
